The Birth of __PERSON_F__
1 In those days Caesar Augustus issued a decree that a census should be taken of the entire Roman world. 2 (This was the first census that took place while[a] Quirinius was governor of Syria.) 3 And everyone went to their own town to register.

4 So __PERSON_E__ also went up from the town of __VILLAGE_A__ in __REGION_A__ to Judea, to Bethlehem the town of __KING_A__, because he belonged to the house and line of __KING_A__. 5 He went there to register with __PERSON_D__, who was pledged to be married to him and was expecting a child. 6 While they were there, the time came for the baby to be born, 7 and she gave birth to her firstborn, a son. She wrapped him in cloths and placed him in a manger, because there was no guest room available for them.

8 And there were shepherds living out in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks at night. 9 An angel of the __MASTER_A__ appeared to them, and the glory of the __MASTER_A__ shone around them, and they were terrified. 10 But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people. 11 Today in the town of __KING_A__ a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the __MASTER_A__. 12 This will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger.”

13 Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host appeared with the angel, praising __MOST_HIGH_A__ and saying,

14 “Glory to __MOST_HIGH_A__ in the highest heaven,
    and on earth peace to those on whom his favor rests.”

15 When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the __MASTER_A__ has told us about.”

16 So they hurried off and found __PERSON_D__ and __PERSON_E__, and the baby, who was lying in the manger. 17 When they had seen him, they spread the word concerning what had been told them about this child, 18 and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them. 19 But __PERSON_D__ treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart. 20 The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising __MOST_HIGH_A__ for all the things they had heard and seen, which were just as they had been told.

21 On the eighth day, when it was time to circumcise the child, he was named __PERSON_F__, the name the angel had given him before he was conceived.

__PERSON_F__ Presented in the Temple
22 When the time came for the purification rites required by the Law of Moses, __PERSON_E__ and __PERSON_D__ took him to __CITY_A__ to present him to the __MASTER_A__ 23 (as it is written in the Law of the __MASTER_A__, “Every firstborn male is to be consecrated to the __MASTER_A__”[b]), 24 and to offer a sacrifice in keeping with what is said in the Law of the __MASTER_A__: “a pair of doves or two young pigeons.”[c]

25 Now there was a man in __CITY_A__ called Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of __PEOPLE_A__, and the __SPIRIT_A__ was on him. 26 It had been revealed to him by the __SPIRIT_A__ that he would not die before he had seen the __MASTER_A__ Messiah. 27 Moved by the Spirit, he went into the __PLACE_A__ courts. When the parents brought in the child __PERSON_F__ to do for him what the custom of the Law required, 28 Simeon took him in his arms and praised __MOST_HIGH_A__, saying:

29 “Sovereign __MASTER_A__, as you have promised,
    you may now dismiss[d] your servant in peace.
30 For my eyes have seen your salvation,
31     which you have prepared in the sight of all nations:
32 a light for revelation to the Gentiles,
    and the glory of your people __PEOPLE_A__.”

33 The child’s father and mother marveled at what was said about him. 34 Then Simeon blessed them and said to __PERSON_D__, his mother: “This child is destined to cause the falling and rising of many in __PEOPLE_A__, and to be a sign that will be spoken against, 35 so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed. And a sword will pierce your own soul too.”

36 There was also a prophet, Anna, the daughter of Penuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was very old; she had lived with her husband seven years after her marriage, 37 and then was a widow until she was eighty-four.[e] She never left the __PLACE_A__ but worshiped night and day, fasting and __REQUEST_A__. 38 Coming up to them at that very moment, she gave thanks to __MOST_HIGH_A__ and spoke about the child to all who were looking forward to the redemption of __CITY_A__.

39 When __PERSON_E__ and __PERSON_D__ had done everything required by the Law of the __MASTER_A__, they returned to __REGION_A__ to their own town of __VILLAGE_A__. 40 And the child grew and became strong; he was filled with wisdom, and the grace of __MOST_HIGH_A__ was on him.

The Boy __PERSON_F__ at the Temple
41 Every year __PERSON_F__ parents went to __CITY_A__ for the Festival of the Passover. 42 When he was twelve years old, they went up to the festival, according to the custom. 43 After the festival was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy __PERSON_F__ stayed behind in __CITY_A__, but they were unaware of it. 44 Thinking he was in their company, they traveled on for a day. Then they began looking for him among their relatives and friends. 45 When they did not find him, they went back to __CITY_A__ to look for him. 46 After three days they found him in the __PLACE_A__ courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions. 47 Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and his answers. 48 When his parents saw him, they were astonished. His mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us like this? Your father and I have been anxiously searching for you.”

49 “Why were you searching for me?” he asked. “Didn’t you know I had to be in my Father’s house?”[f] 50 But they did not understand what he was saying to them.

51 Then he went down to __VILLAGE_A__ with them and was obedient to them. But his mother treasured all these things in her heart. 52 And __PERSON_F__ grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with __MOST_HIGH_A__ and man.
translations:
__PERSON_F__的出生  
1 那时候凯撒奥古斯都发了一个命令，要对整个罗马世界做普查。2 （这次普查是第一次在叙利亚总督奎里尼乌斯当政时进行的。）3 大家都去自己家乡去登记。  

4 所以__PERSON_E__也从__(VILLAGE_A)__镇在__(REGION_A)__上去犹太，去__(KING_A)__的城伯利恒，因为他属于__(KING_A)__的家和血统。5 他和已订婚的__PERSON_D__去那里登记，__PERSON_D__怀着孩子。6 他们在那里时，生孩子的时间到了，7 她生了头生的儿子，用布包裹起来，放进马槽，因为没有客房给他们。  

8 附近田野里有牧羊人晚上守着羊群。9 一个__MASTER_A__的天使出现他们身边，__MASTER_A__的荣耀照在他们四周，他们害怕了。10 天使对他们说：“不要怕，我带给你们好消息，要使大众欢乐。11 今天在__(KING_A)__镇，你们救主出生了，就是弥赛亚，__MASTER_A__。12 这是给你们的记号：你们会找到用布包着躺在马槽里的婴孩。”  

13 突然大量天军和天使一同出现，赞美__MOST_HIGH_A__，说，  

14 “荣耀归与最高的__MOST_HIGH_A__在天上，  
地上平安给他喜悦的人。”  

15 天使离开天上后，牧羊人彼此说：“我们去伯利恒看看__MASTER_A__告诉我们的这事。”  

16 他们急忙去找到__PERSON_D__和__PERSON_E__及躺在马槽里的婴儿。17 看到他后，他们传讲关于孩子的信息，18 所有人听见牧羊人说的都惊讶。19 __PERSON_D__把这些事放在心里思考。20 牧羊人回去赞美和称颂__MOST_HIGH_A__，为听到所见的事都像告诉他们的。  

21 第八天给孩子行割礼，那时候给他起名叫__PERSON_F__，这是天使怀孕前给他的名。  

__PERSON_F__在殿里奉献  
22 依摩西律法洁净的日子到了，__PERSON_E__和__PERSON_D__带他去__(CITY_A)__奉献给__MASTER_A__。23 这是照着__MASTER_A__律法写的，“每头生的男孩都要献给__MASTER_A__”[b]。24 也照律法献祭，“一对斑鸠或两只小鸽子。”[c]  

25 __(CITY_A)__有个名叫西缅的人，义且虔诚，盼望以色列安慰，圣灵在他身上。26 圣灵指示他，死前必看见__MASTER_A__弥赛亚。27 圣灵感动时进殿，父母带孩子__PERSON_F__来，行律法习俗。28 西缅抱孩赞美__MOST_HIGH_A__说：  

29 “主啊，如你所应许，  
现在可以平安解你仆人走了。  
30 因为我亲眼见了你的救恩，  
31 是你为万国预备。  
32 是照亮外邦人的光，  
是你百姓以色列的荣耀。”  

33 孩子的父母对他说的话惊奇。34 西缅祝福他们，对__PERSON_D__说：“此孩使许多人在以色列跌倒和兴起，为要作被人反对的记号。35 许多心思要显露，你的心也要被刀刺。”  

36 还有先知亚拿，是亚设支派、比努埃勒女儿，年纪大，嫁后与丈夫同住七年，37 丈夫死后，直到八十四岁。她不离殿，昼夜敬拜，禁食祈求。38 她来时感谢__MOST_HIGH_A__，对盼望耶路撒冷得救赎的人讲孩故事。  

39 __PERSON_E__和__PERSON_D__照律法行完一切事，回__(REGION_A)__自己家乡__(VILLAGE_A)__。40 孩子长大强壮，充满智慧，__MOST_HIGH_A__恩典在他身上。  

少年__PERSON_F__在殿里  
41 每年__PERSON_F__父母去__(CITY_A)__守逾越节。42 他十二岁时，照例上节日。43 节后归路，__PERSON_F__留在殿里，父母不知。44 想他同行，走一天，便开始找亲友。45 找不到，回__(CITY_A)__找他。46 三天后在殿内经师中间找到他，坐着听问。47 听见的人惊奇他的聪明和回答。48 父母见他惊奇，母亲说：“儿子，为什么这样对待我们？你父亲和我紧急找你。”  

49 他问：“你们为何找我？不知道我应当在我父的家么？”[f] 50 他们不明白他说的话。  

51 他随父母下__(VILLAGE_A)__，顺从他们。母亲把这些事藏心里。52 __PERSON_F__智慧身量增长，在__MOST_HIGH_A__和人中蒙恩。
